title: Quantization of nilpotent coadjoint $GL_N$-orbit closures in positive characteristics
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive group over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic $p$, good for the root system of $G$. The closures of $G$-orbits in the Hilbert nullcone of the coadjoint representation are conical affine Poisson varieties, generically of full rank, known as {\em nilpotent coadjoint orbits}. In this paper, we classify the filtered Hamiltonian quantizations of these orbit closures for $G = GL_N$ and any $p > 0$.
